name: POC1 — Call Review and Delegation (Business partition only)

nodes.name: Call Event Webhook
nodes.notes: INBOUND. Call/transcript event from CallRail. Business partition only (05_ §2). Payload is treated as EXTERNAL-UNTRUSTED until the envelope node.

nodes.name: Apply External-Untrusted Envelope
nodes.notes: BOUNDARY. Envelope applied before any classification. `content_forwarded` is the B-2 observation the packet §3 asks to be logged.

nodes.name: AI OS — Open Review Case
nodes.notes: AUTHORITY. The AI OS opens the review case and owns the queue. n8n does not classify, decide, or store state (05_ §2: providers never hold the rulebook).

nodes.name: Wait for Owner Decision
nodes.notes: TRANSPORT ONLY. The provider carries the pause; the DECISION is made on the AI OS/Discord card and posted back to this resume URL as an opaque token. packet §3: 'a provider human-in-loop feature may carry the pause, never decide it.'

nodes.name: Verify Decision Token With AI OS
nodes.notes: AUTHORITY. The resume token proves nothing by itself. The AI OS validates it and returns the authorized ActionRequest, or refuses. Fail-closed.

nodes.name: Send Assignment
nodes.notes: EXECUTION. Provider executes the AI-OS-authored ActionRequest verbatim. Idempotency key travels inside the ActionRequest (event identity is core, 04_ §2).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({provider_result: $json, action_request_id: $('Verify Decision Token With AI OS').item.json.action_request?.id}) }}

nodes.name: Return Receipt To AI OS
nodes.notes: EVIDENCE. Raw provider result only. The wrapper transforms it into a D-EC_-conformant receipt; the provider never mints the receipt.

nodes.name: Record Refusal
nodes.notes: FAIL-CLOSED path. A refusal is recorded, never silently dropped.

main.node: Verify Decision Token With AI OS
